title: A fixed exceptional parameter forces regularity on a surface blowup chain
statement: Let $(A,\mathfrak m,k)$ be a commutative Noetherian normal local domain of dimension $2$ [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], whose maximal-ideal-adic completion is a normal domain [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $(X_0,p_0)=(\operatorname{Spec}A,\mathfrak m)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum], and for every $i\geq0$ let $X_{i+1}\to X_i$ be the ordinary blowup at the reduced closed point $p_i$, with a closed point $p_{i+1}$ lying over $p_i$ [def-nagata-global-blowup]. Suppose every residue-field map $\kappa(p_i)\to\kappa(p_{i+1})$ is an isomorphism. Suppose there is a single element $u\in\mathfrak m$ such that, for every $i\geq1$, its image generates in $\mathcal O_{X_i,p_i}$ the ideal of the exceptional divisor of $X_i\to X_{i-1}$. Then $\mathcal O_{X_j,p_j}$ is regular for some finite $j\geq0$ [def-weil-regular-scheme].
